comment: Pinned inputs of engine/ruby-wasm/build.sh. sha256 is of the downloaded file. null means not yet recorded (the host was unreachable where the recipe was written): the build refuses to start while an input it uses is null; build.sh --fetch-only downloads it afresh and prints the hash to pin. toolchain: used by that --toolchain only. vfs_only: used with wasi-vfs only.

ruby.license: Ruby OR BSD-2-Clause (bundled parts under their own licenses, see LEGAL)

libyaml.note: ruby_wasm downloads the same release from github.com/yaml/libyaml/releases

zlib.note: the URL ruby_wasm 2.10.1 uses; sha256 as zlib.net publishes it for 1.3.1, not re-fetched where the recipe was written (github.com blocked; zlib.net answers automated clients with a bot check)

ubuntu_zlib.note: Debian's repack of zlib 1.3.1 (contrib/ removed); the library sources are upstream's

ruby_wasm_gem.note: build tool (rbwasm packager); its wasi-vfs packer writes the stdlib image but no code of it ships

binaryen.note: wasm-opt (asyncify, strip). ruby_wasm 2.10.1's default binaryen is version 108 too. A build tool: its output is the transformed binary, no binaryen code ships

wasi_sdk.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception (LLVM, compiler-rt); wasi-libc: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT, musl parts MIT
wasi_sdk.ships: wasi-libc and compiler-rt builtins are linked in
wasi_sdk.note: the toolchain ruby_wasm 2.10.1 uses for Ruby 3.4 (wasi_sdk_version 22.0); the stock binary's producers section says clang 18.1.2

wasi_vfs.note: ruby_wasm 2.10.1's WASI_VFS_VERSION; only published as a GitHub release asset

ubuntu_wasi_libc.license: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT, musl parts MIT
ubuntu_wasi_libc.note: Ubuntu 24.04's own wasi-libc. Not a newer snapshot: from mid-2024 libwasi-emulated-mman.a defines mprotect, which overrides Ruby 3.4.1's no-op stub (wasm/missing.c) and fails the fiber guard pages in Init_Cont, so ruby_init exits (seen with the 20240708 snapshot)

ubuntu_compiler_rt.note: with the system clang-18, lld-18 and llvm-18 of Ubuntu 24.04 (18.1.3)
